question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Out of the blue
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. "Unexpectedly."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: 
 
• The phrase 'Out of the blue' means 'something happens suddenly, without any warning or expectation.'
 
• *Example*:
 
 
• *​Within a few months of meeting, Smith proposed to Rachel to marry him **out of the blue.***
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 2 'Unexpectedly,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ *Unexpectedly.*
